prompt: Are a fine and a license suspension the same consequence?

choices.text: Yes
choices.feedback: Not quite. Texas no longer uses the former Driver Responsibility Program point surcharge system. Convictions still become part of the driving record, and repeated moving violations or serious offenses can lead to suspension, revocation, fines, or other consequences under current law. Courts and the licensing agency may act through different processes, so a fine, conviction, administrative action, and license suspension are not interchangeable.
